learning_outcomes.text: Propose systems and carry out projects on basic fluid energy installations.
Acquire knowledge in energy and fluid matters, enabling them to learn new methods and theories, and providing them with versatility to adapt to new situations.
Express and communicate ideas and systems related to energy and fluids.
Understand and prepare professional technical documentation, in the context of activities related to thermodynamics and fluids.
Master the calculations for fluid installations and thermodynamic systems.

syllabus_topics: Integral relations for a control volume
Continuity equation or conservation of mass
Viscous flow in conduits. Primary losses. Localized losses in conduits
teaching_methods: Reflective reading and in-depth study of material

assessment_methods.method: Submission of reports / Activities proposed in class and laboratory practices

assessment_rules: To pass the subject, the sum of the assessment activities must be equal to or greater than 5 out of 10. A final theoretical-practical exam and a theoretical-practical resit exam will be held; students who have not passed or wish to improve their grade may take the resit. The written test requires a minimum grade of 5. For students who do not pass either exam, the grade recorded will be the sum of the resit exam (90%) and activities (10%). Only students who do not take either exam will be marked as 'not presented'.
